Core: On the map, follow the Thames and label: its source, Oxford, Reading, London, the Thames Barrier, the estuary, and two counties.
questions.a: Correct labels in order from west to east

questions.q: Extend: Name your own county or the nearest city to you.

questions.a: Sea levels are rising, so high tides may get higher

questions.q: Big question: what does the Thames pass on its journey?
questions.a: Countryside and villages, then towns like Reading and cities like Oxford and London, then the sea
